description: M7 parity I — young LOW-vuln (age 34), IG corporate bond ETF. Moderate knowledge, high RT, all rules pass, SUITABLE. Paired with scenario 126.
client_narrative: Erika Makinen is 34 years old. Their gross annual income is approximately 55,000 euros (around 4,583 euros per month). They hold 200,000 euros in liquid savings and wish to invest 40,000 euros with a 6-year investment horizon. In terms of financial background, the client has moderate investment experience, including equities, mutual funds, and standard bond instruments. Their investment approach is moderate — they rate their risk tolerance at 6 out of 10. They have confirmed they can afford to lose the entire 40,000 euros if the investment performs poorly.
product_narrative: The product is a UCITS exchange-traded fund tracking the Bloomberg Euro Aggregate Corporate Index, holding EUR-denominated investment-grade bonds rated at minimum BBB-. The fund publishes a KID, trades on regulated exchanges, uses no leverage, and contains no embedded derivatives. It is classified NON-COMPLEX under MiFID II Article 25(4)(a). The recommended minimum holding period is three years.
